# English

## What changed

Describe the user-visible behaviour and why the change is needed.

## Validation

List the exact automated tests and any bounded hardware checks that were run.
Do not claim physical-display success from source inspection or synthetic tests.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No real device serial number, USB/PnP instance ID, pairing token, private key,
      private diagnostic capture or contributor-specific absolute path is added.
- [ ] Driver, update, transport and input changes preserve ownership and
      fail-closed checks.
- [ ] New third-party material includes its licence and provenance.

## Compatibility catalogue, when applicable

- [ ] The report was manually transcribed from reviewed public, non-unique
      facts; no Issue body, support-bundle JSON, attachment name or raw
      diagnostic output was copied into the catalogue.
- [ ] Unverified capabilities remain marked as unverified, and requested Hz is
      not presented as measured FPS.
- [ ] The catalogue `--check` command passes, and generated schema and Markdown
      files are synchronised.

---

# 简体中文

## 变更内容

说明用户可见的行为变化，以及为什么需要这项变更。

## 验证

列出实际运行的自动化测试和有明确范围的硬件检查。
不得仅凭源码检查或模拟测试宣称实体显示器验证成功。

## 安全与隐私

- [ ] 未添加真实设备序列号、USB/PnP 实例 ID、配对 token、私钥、私密诊断捕获内容或贡献者专属绝对路径。
- [ ] 驱动、更新、传输和输入相关变更保留所有权与失败关闭检查。
- [ ] 新增的第三方材料包含许可证和来源信息。

## 兼容性目录（如适用）

- [ ] 报告内容仅从经过审查的公开、非唯一事实中人工整理；未将 Issue 正文、支持包 JSON、附件名称或原始诊断输出复制到兼容性目录。
- [ ] 未经验证的能力仍标记为未经验证，并且没有把请求 Hz 表述为实测 FPS。
- [ ] 兼容性目录的 `--check` 命令通过，生成的 schema 与 Markdown 文件保持同步。
